pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

3. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   D. Treat Rocks as rumours only.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

12. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   D. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
